title: RuntimeConfig
description: DRAFT v0.1. Per-environment config the Angular apps fetch from /config.json before bootstrap (provideAppInitializer). Lets one build run in any environment (native, docker compose, Codespaces) without a rebuild. Contains no secrets. See SPEC FR10 and DECISIONS #8.

environment.description: Shown in the shell header so a demo always states where it is running.

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Go API, e.g. http://localhost:8080.

provider.description: fdc3 = getAgent() against a Desktop Agent (falls back to in-memory on timeout); in-memory = BroadcastChannel only.

auth.description: Reserved seam for an OAuth2/OIDC provider. Auth is a non-goal (SPEC §3): `enabled` must be false in this POC and no login is implemented. The shape mirrors common MSAL/OIDC SPA settings so a real provider could be wired in behind an AUTH token without changing callers.

clientId.description: Public client ID (not a secret). Empty in this POC.

authority.description: Issuer/authority URL. Empty in this POC.
